info.title: India's Journey API
info.description: Read-only indicator catalogue (groups, indicators, compare, downloads, articles) plus session-authenticated saved charts. Sign in with Google or Microsoft from the web app; Swagger "Try it out" then reuses that session and sends the CSRF token automatically.
